snippet.title: Beatdown City Survivors - Official Gameplay Trailer | Indie Horror Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Get ready to destroy hordes of nuclear monsters in Beatdown City Survivors, an immersive sandbox survival roguelite where everything is your weapon - from knives to pipes and even pigeons – and you can break everything, ignite gas, electrify water, upgrade yourself, you based, and your team, and much more. Beatdown City Survivors is coming soon to PC.
